name: mdrv_list_folder
description: List a folder's contents. Pass `folder` = 'root' for the top level (default), or a folder UUID to open that folder. Returns { folder, breadcrumb, folders, files }: `folder` is the current folder (null at root), `breadcrumb` is the ancestor chain root-first, `folders` are the subfolders, and `files` are the (non-trashed) files here. Each file has id (UUID), name, content_type, size_bytes, starred, folder_id, created_at. Use this to discover folder and file `id`s before get/move/delete.

folder.description: 'root' for the drive root (default), or a folder UUID to list that folder.
